title: How to Make a Resume in India: Format, Personal Details and Worked Examples
seoTitle: How to Make a Resume: India Guide for Freshers & Pros
seoDescription: Make a resume with contact, summary, skills, experience and education, written as results. Indian practice on photo, DOB, CGPA and length, with examples.
excerpt: Resume vs CV vs biodata, which personal details Indian employers still expect, how to show CGPA, the right length, and before-and-after bullets that turn plain duties into achievements.
